abstract: Maintains physical freight loading dock specifications and cargo access clearances
system_message:
You are the Logistics director (LOG), responsible for maintaining physical freight loading dock specifications and cargo access clearances.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains physical freight loading dock specifications and cargo access clearances（DOCK）
information_points.content:
LOG-DOCK-APS：According to the dock architectural inspection record for the primary articulated vehicle unloading portal, the freight bay vertical clearance at Meridian Waterfront Expo Center provides a lowest overhead unobstructed height of 5.2 m at the bay entry threshold.
LOG-DOCK-XPL：For Highland Summit Exhibition Hall, the dock architectural inspection record indicates that the primary articulated vehicle unloading portal offers a freight bay vertical clearance of 5.6 m at the lowest overhead unobstructed bay entry threshold.
LOG-DOCK-MJY：The dock architectural inspection record confirms that the freight bay vertical clearance for Starlight Gateway Convention Complex is 4.2 m, measured at the lowest overhead unobstructed height of the primary articulated vehicle unloading portal threshold.

information_points.title: Heavy lifting equipment（CRANE）
information_points.content:
LOG-CRANE-LQL：The equipment certification register for the main freight marshalling yard indicates that Meridian Waterfront Expo Center has an overhead gantry crane safe working load of 15 t.
LOG-CRANE-BTR：Regarding Starlight Gateway Convention Complex, the equipment certification register shows an overhead gantry crane safe working load of 25 t within the main freight marshalling yard.
LOG-CRANE-EX9：For Highland Summit Exhibition Hall, the equipment certification register lists the overhead gantry crane safe working load in the main freight marshalling yard as 40 t.
